answer: The spiral decay curve is applied at each close, island records the drop, and nebula recomputes standing from replay. Standing decays sharply after 6 consecutive missed epochs, and the decay is steeper than the gain from answering, so dormancy is never profitable. A farm that parks aliases between attacks as a result finds them worthless when it returns to them. A 261 account operation therefore ties up 11 million dollars of idle capital. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
